readout_other: hindlimb EMG (AUC) evoked by motor cortex electrical stimulation; tremor EMG; somatosensory evoked potentials; H&E histology
direction_notes: Sonication at T12 inhibited the evoked hindlimb motor response and suppressed harmaline-induced tremor; sonication at L3 at 2.2 MPa facilitated it. Ascending SSEPs were unaffected.
safety_notes: H&E histology showed no hemorrhage or neuronal damage; thermocouple temperature rise after 2 min of sonication was 3.5, 1.6 and 0.6 degrees for 2.2, 1.4 and 0.8 MPa.

device.model: in-house single-element 3 MHz PZT-4 transducer, 6 mm diameter, 3D-printed lens, 10 mm radius of curvature

timing.protocol_description: Pulse train of 200 ms, 0.5 ms tone bursts at 1 kHz PRF, delivered 1 s before each electrical cortical stimulation, interstimulus interval 2 s; sessions of 100 trials separated by 5 min. For the tremor model, 1 min baseline, 1 min tsFUS at 1.4 MPa on T12, 1 min rest.
